title: VEL-COLETTE-LOOKRICH-01 · How to look rich without going broke

cards.text: VEL-COLETTE-LOOKRICH-01 · HOW TO LOOK RICH WITHOUT GOING BROKE

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: Colette Wool Tote. Port of a 44s organic IG reel (@sara_liberale) that counts down 10 best-selling shoes over Amazon PDP screen recordings with a greenscreen talking-head cutout on top. We keep the hook and the countdown retention engine but collapse ten items into ONE product satisfying FIVE criteria, counted 5 to 1, every number a physical fact of the Colette, number one is the no-logo fact. 137 words, 45.4s, 181 wpm, one continuous VO take. Offer pulled live today: pre-order $119.99, was $149.99, save $30, Caramel + Espresso, ships early October, STILL PRE-ORDER WITH ZERO DELIVERED BUYERS. Section 6 of the doc carries the TALKING HEAD build, which is the one asset that does not exist yet.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: How to Look Rich Without Going Broke. Best Selling Shoe Edition.

Four-up collage grid of aspirational shoe shots. Big white bold outlined hook text over the seam, then a white-box card reading Best selling shoe edition. Creator is a greenscreen cutout floating center frame in a white ribbed tank, hair up, holding a small handheld content mic.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Promise of a method, not a product. She is going to teach you something, so you stay.

Grid includes a Jimmy Choo box and Chanel-hardware mules. We cannot mirror that. THE MIC IS THE FORMAT SIGNAL, keep it.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Starting off with number 10 with 669 clicks are these jeweled heeled sandals.
Full-screen Amazon PDP screen recording. Hero image top, title bar with a Clicks 669 badge, AI question chips, swatch row with real prices and struck-through compare-at prices. Cutout floats center.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Receipts, not claims. You are watching a real product page.

The screen IS the proof device. This is what we replace with our own live PDP recording.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: For 8 with 2,000 clicks are these rhinestone wrap heels.
Same PDP grammar, new item. Cutout has jumped to bottom-center.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Escalation. The click count is climbing, so the payoff is always one beat away.

Cutout moves between nearly every segment. That movement keeps a static screen alive and marks each new number.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Number 6 with 3,000 clicks are these colorful satin slingbacks.
PDP screen, swatch row with two colourways and prices along the bottom.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Still climbing. ~3.8s per item, never a wasted frame.

Item pacing is 3.8s. Our numbered beats run 3.2 to 5.2s, same rhythm.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Number 2 with 6,000 clicks are these rhinestone mules.
PDP screen, Clicks 6K badge pinned top, four swatches at $52.99 along the bottom.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Near the top of the countdown. Highest tension.

The number one slot is the biggest payoff. Ours is the no-logo fact.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Comment shop for all the links to all the things, and like and follow for more.
Back to the four-up collage grid, cutout center. Closes where it opened.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Flat, unhurried. No urgency performance.

Organic CTA. Ours becomes I left the link below.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: How to look rich without going broke. Fall tote edition.

FOUR-UP GRID of four Colette stills: 003-street-coffee-run, 076-macro-gold-disc, 088-setdown-park-bench, 019-cafe-bistro-chair. Hook text big white bold outlined across the seam, Fall tote edition in a white rounded box below. Cutout center.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Method promised. She stays to learn the checklist.

LAW SWAP: 100% Colette footage, all Caramel. No designer box, no competitor hardware, no logo of any kind.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: This is the Colette Wool Tote from Velantra.
Bag in the crook of the elbow, full silhouette reads. Post overlay: the Colette Wool Tote. Cutout bottom-left.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Plain and immediate. The brand gets the credit for everything that follows.

House law: product intro by 0:06. Lands at 0:03.2. Asset 002-street-crook-elbow.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Five things that make a bag read expensive, and this has all five.
Entryway bench, coat and scarf on the hooks behind it, hand lifting the bag off the bench. Cutout bottom-left.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
The verdict lands inside the frame line, not held for the end.

The reference's countdown converted into a CRITERIA device. Every answer is a physical fact of our bag, which is how we become the best one without comparing to anything. Asset 039-home-entry-bench.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Number five, it stands up on its own, even empty.
THE SET-DOWN. Hands place it on the bench and release. It holds. Hold the release frame. Cutout top-right. Card: NUMBER 5.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Demonstrate, never describe. The clip does the work, the line just names it.

Asset 088-setdown-park-bench.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Number four, the body is cashmere-feel brushed wool. It has the hand of a good coat.
Macro, thumb pressing into the nap, fibre visible. Cutout bottom-center. Card: NUMBER 4.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Tactile. She can feel it through the screen.

COMPLIANCE: cashmere-FEEL only, never a fibre claim. Asset 075-macro-felt-fibre.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Number three, the handles are wrapped in leather right where your hand sits.
Macro, the hand closing around the leather grip. The leather is what fills frame. Cutout bottom-left. Card: NUMBER 3.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
The detail nobody photographs, which is why it reads as real.

CORRECTED. 077-macro-handle-wrap was rejected on 8/22 because the frame reads as a WOOL handle and contradicts the line. Asset 081-macro-hand-on-handle.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Number two, aged gold hardware and a leather belt across the front.
Slow drift along the belt across the front face and out into the free-hanging gold disc cap. Cutout top-left. Card: NUMBER 2.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Hardware is the fastest visual shorthand for expensive.

CORRECTED. 078-macro-belt-through-strap and 082-macro-belt-curve-profile are BOTH ESPRESSO. Asset 076-macro-gold-disc.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: And number one, there is no logo on it anywhere.
Woman on the street holding the bag front-on, blank panel to camera, checking her phone. Cutout bottom-right. Card: NUMBER 1.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
The payoff slot. The angle resolves here: looking rich is the absence of the logo, not the presence of it.

Returns a person to screen at the exact moment the ad makes its status claim, so it PROVES the claim instead of asserting it. Asset 015-street-phone-check.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: (one second of silence)
Bag standing on the sofa with a throw and an open book. No caption card. Cutout bottom-right.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
The beat lands. Let it breathe before the proof.

Passes the placement test. Asset 043-home-sofa-corner.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: I filled it all the way up, my laptop, a water bottle and a sweater, set it down, and it stayed standing.

FIVE CUTS. 056-open-wide-mouth-hero (laptop and a rolled knit going in), then 059-pack-laptop-slide IN-POINT 0.3s, 062-pack-water-bottle IN-POINT 0.5s, 060-pack-sweater-fold IN-POINT 0.3s, then 046-home-kitchen-counter for the hands-off set-down. Hold silent. Cutout OUT for the load-in, returns on the set-down.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Demonstration, not a claim. One caption card per noun, synced to the cuts.

NO LIVED-TIME PROOF. Still pre-order, zero delivered buyers, so she cannot say she carried it all week. IN-POINT LAW: cut on the frame where the action happens, a blanket 2.0s lands on the aftermath.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: It comes in caramel
Caramel on the closet shelf. Cutout bottom-left.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Choice, briefly.

One cut per colourway, same doctrine as one cut per noun on capacity. Asset 045-home-closet-shelf.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: and espresso.
Espresso by the radiator window. THE ONLY ESPRESSO SHOT IN THE AD. Cutout bottom-left.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Choice, briefly.

CORRECTED. The whole VEL-DUO set was going to be used here and is UNUSABLE: every duo clip pairs the Colette with a structured leather handbag carrying a visible turn-lock, which is a second product on screen and reads as competitor trade dress. Logged unusable 8/22. Asset 050-home-radiator-window.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: It's on pre-order right now, thirty dollars off, shipping early October. I left the link below.

LIVE PDP SCREEN RECORDING, one continuous unbroken take. $149.99 struck to $119.99, Save $30.00, pre-order banner with the October ship date, both swatches, Add to Cart, cart at $119.99. Cutout bottom-right then out.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Flat, no urgency performance. The page does the closing.

USE THE EXISTING 8/22 CAPTURE, pdp-capture/pdp-screenrec.mp4. Price has not moved. NEVER use ScreenRecording_08-05-2026, it shows the stale $189.99/$149.99 offer and would burn a false price into the ad. THIRTY DOLLARS OFF, never thirty off: the STT gate read the short form back as thirty PERCENT off.

cards.title: OURS · VEL-COLETTE-LOOKRICH-01, 45.4s · ALL CARAMEL except shot 16  ·  The Colette Wool Tote, Velantra

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: OFFER OF RECORD
cards.text: Pulled live 2026-08-29: pre-order $119.99, compare-at $149.99, save $30, Caramel and Espresso, ships early October. Still pre-order, ZERO delivered buyers. No lived-time proof, no review quotes, no click counts anywhere.

cards.title: THE TALKING HEAD, the one missing asset
cards.text: No Colette greenscreen creator exists. Reference creator: woman 35 to 45, low bun, WHITE RIBBED TANK, thin gold chain, small hoops, forearm tattoo, holding a SMALL HANDHELD CONTENT MIC near her chin, chest-up, slight high angle, warm flat indoor light, talking continuously with light hand movement. The mic is the format signal, it says creator recording a voiceover rather than commercial. Keep it.

cards.title: TALKING HEAD BUILD
cards.text: Per the Velantra Avatar SOP. 1) Pinterest reference, one calm still, style and vibe only. 2) Nano Banana Pro i2i with the identity block in section 6 of the doc, generate three, pick the unartifacted one, regenerate if it reads too close to the Pinterest face. 3) Animate on the finished VO in HeyGen, natural micro-movement, light hand-talk on the mic hand. 4) Key clean, comp at a quarter of frame height.

cards.title: DESPILL
cards.text: Neutral garment against green. Despill at 0.5 renders the white tank PINK. Keep it low and check the tank in pixels, not on the read.

cards.title: CUTOUT CHOREOGRAPHY
cards.text: Mirror the reference and move her between nearly every segment rather than the single house jump at the 3/4 mark. On a countdown the movement also marks each new number. She drops out entirely for the load-in beats so the demonstration owns the screen, then returns on the set-down.

cards.title: ASSET CORRECTIONS THIS PASS
cards.text: VEL-DUO-020 out, it is a second product. 004-street-walking-side out, espresso. 049-home-mirror-ootd out, shoulder carry and the drop is 6.3in so hand or forearm only. 007-street-shopfront-pause out, espresso. 077-macro-handle-wrap out, reads as a wool handle. 078 and 082 out, both espresso.

cards.title: NEVER REACH FOR
cards.text: ScreenRecording_08-05-2026 (stale offer), VEL-COL-009 (duplicate bag), 012 (leash merge), 018 (missing disc cap), 090 (cool grey body), 079 and every shoulder-carry pull, and the entire VEL-DUO set.

cards.title: AVATAR POSITIONING
cards.text: Avatar B, the woman who wants the world and not the logo. The phrase without going broke appears ONCE, in the hook, and never again. The body runs on discernment, never on being priced out. The price is never framed against another brand, it just appears struck through on the real page at the end.

cards.title: AUDIO
cards.text: Voice NBIPq5xdnIg9kaBH5Ape Woman Over 40, eleven_v3 Creative, stability 0.0 similarity 0.85 speaker boost on. One continuous take, three takes, keep the one nearest 185 wpm. Respell Vell-Ahn-Trah. STT read-back gate every take. tighten.py to cap gaps at 0.12s. Normalize to -14 LUFS BEFORE import.

cards.title: CAPTIONS
cards.text: Hook line big white bold rounded sans, thin dark outline. Fall tote edition and every NUMBER card in a white rounded box with black text, upper third, punched in on the word. Body captions word-synced, sentence case, no terminal punctuation, 4 to 8 words a card. One card per noun on capacity. Known ASR defects: Culette, culotte, Velontra, and pre-order splitting into a bare pre card. Fix by hand.

cards.title: SCRIM
cards.text: Over the macros and the PDP recording, wash a feathered LOCAL box measured to the ink x-extents. Never darken the whole frame. PDP cards need a black pill at 72%.

cards.title: STANDING GATES
cards.text: Load test: would she put THAT in the bag on THIS occasion, and does it match what the VO says is inside. Placement test: her own floor, a chair, a bench, a counter, a car seat yes, a public floor never. In-point test: cut on the frame where the action happens. Every cutaway face-free except the creator layer.

cards.title: 30s CUT
cards.text: Drop numbers three and two, shorten the load-in to the laptop only. Lands at 31s and 96 words with hook, intro, three criteria, the no-logo payoff, offer and CTA intact.
